description: List Mouser's tabs: index, title, active, local folder or remote host.
name: tabs_list

description: Visible text of a tab's screen.

tab.description: tab index from tabs_list (default: the active tab)

name: screen_read

description: The last lines of a tab's scrollback (above the screen).

tab.description: tab index from tabs_list (default: the active tab)

name: scrollback_read

description: Type text into a tab as keystrokes (no Enter added). Asks the user in Mouser first.

tab.description: tab index from tabs_list (default: the active tab)

name: shell_type

description: Run a command line in a tab's shell (typed, then Enter). Only when the shell is at its prompt. Asks the user in Mouser first.

tab.description: tab index from tabs_list (default: the active tab)

name: shell_run

description: List a folder (name, kind, size, mtime).

path.description: absolute, or relative to the tab's local folder

tab.description: tab index from tabs_list (default: the active tab)

name: files_list

description: Read a text file (up to 1 MiB).

max_bytes.description: read at most this many bytes

path.description: absolute, or relative to the tab's local folder

tab.description: tab index from tabs_list (default: the active tab)

name: files_read

description: Create a folder (and parents). Asks first.

path.description: absolute, or relative to the tab's local folder

tab.description: tab index from tabs_list (default: the active tab)

name: files_mkdir

description: Copy a file or folder (never overwrites). Asks first.

from.description: absolute, or relative to the tab's local folder

tab.description: tab index from tabs_list (default: the active tab)

to.description: absolute, or relative to the tab's local folder

name: files_copy

description: Alias of file_move. Move or rename (never overwrites). Asks first.

from.description: absolute, or relative to the tab's local folder

tab.description: tab index from tabs_list (default: the active tab)

to.description: absolute, or relative to the tab's local folder

name: files_move

description: Move or rename a file or folder (never overwrites). files_move is the same tool. Asks first.

from.description: absolute, or relative to the tab's local folder

tab.description: tab index from tabs_list (default: the active tab)

to.description: absolute, or relative to the tab's local folder

name: file_move

description: Sync two local paths. direction is push (from → to), pull (to → from) or both (default). conflict is newer (default; the strictly newer mtime wins) or refuse (leave both, report the clash). A file that would be replaced is moved to Mouser's trash first. dry_run lists the changes and writes nothing. Directories need recursive (default true). Asks first.

from.description: absolute, or relative to the tab's local folder

tab.description: tab index from tabs_list (default: the active tab)

to.description: absolute, or relative to the tab's local folder

name: file_sync

description: Sync a local path with a path on a remote host (the tab's ssh, or host). push uploads, pull downloads, both (default) copies whichever side is missing or newer. Same conflict, trash, dry_run and recursive rules as file_sync. Asks first.

host.description: user@host or host; omitted: the tab's remote shell

local.description: absolute, or relative to the tab's local folder

port.description: ssh port when host is set

tab.description: tab index from tabs_list (default: the active tab)

name: remote_file_sync

description: Download a remote file or directory (recursive, default true) onto a local path. Same as remote_file_sync direction pull: a newer local file is kept, otherwise the local file goes to the trash and the remote copy replaces it. dry_run lists that and writes nothing. Asks first.

host.description: user@host or host; omitted: the tab's remote shell

port.description: ssh port when host is set

tab.description: tab index from tabs_list (default: the active tab)

to.description: absolute, or relative to the tab's local folder

name: file_download

description: Upload a local file or directory (recursive, default true) onto a remote path. Same as remote_file_sync direction push. A replaced remote file's previous bytes go to Mouser's trash. dry_run lists that and writes nothing. Asks first.

from.description: absolute, or relative to the tab's local folder

host.description: user@host or host; omitted: the tab's remote shell

port.description: ssh port when host is set

tab.description: tab index from tabs_list (default: the active tab)

name: file_upload

description: Every built-in and user theme, and which one is active.
name: list_themes

description: One theme's dark and light values (colours, cursor, accent, palette, selection).
name: get_theme

description: Make a theme the active one: saved in preferences and applied to this window on the next frame. Asks first.
name: set_theme

description: Create a user theme. name is required. Missing colours fall back to Red Star. variant is dark, light or both (default both). A short palette is padded with the default ANSI colours. A bad colour is an error and nothing is written. Asks first.
name: create_theme

description: Copy a theme. name is the copy's name; omitted, it is "<theme> copy" (then "<theme> copy 2", …). Asks first.
name: duplicate_theme

description: Merge colour fields into a user theme and save it. Omitted fields stay. variant dark, light or both (default both). Built-in themes are read-only: the error says to use duplicate_theme. Asks first.
name: edit_theme

description: Delete a theme. The last remaining theme is refused. A user theme's files go to Mouser's trash. A built-in is hidden (it stays in the program; themes/.hidden lists it) and any copy on disk is trashed. Deleting the active theme switches to the default if that remains, otherwise another theme, and saves that. Asks first.
name: delete_theme

description: Move to Mouser's trash ($MOUSER_HOME/trash); nothing is deleted for good. Asks first.

path.description: absolute, or relative to the tab's local folder

tab.description: tab index from tabs_list (default: the active tab)

name: files_trash

description: List Mouser's modes (commander, chat, preferences, plugins): name, hotkey, which is on and whether it has the keyboard.
name: modes_list

description: Turn a mode on by name or hotkey (its own name again turns modes off). Asks first.
name: modes_switch

description: Every action of the current mode that applies now to its selected item and view state (a file, folder, image, clip; list or fullscreen view ...): the same list as its right-click menu, with id, arg, label, key, enabled and destructive.
name: mode_actions

description: Run one action from mode_actions (id and arg), as its key would. Asks first; destructive file changes (delete, move, rename, paste) also ask again on the mode's own approval card and never overwrite.
name: mode_action
